text:
Tara M.: FYI candidate Esha B. emailed: her flight gets in late and she's breastfeeding; asked if we can move the loop to the evening or else provide a dedicated lactation/pumping room + fridge.
Ken (Recruiter): Evening is a stretch for some panelists but possible between 5:30-7:30pm. Do we have volunteers for an evening slot?
Arman (People Ops): We can do a 6:00 PM start if panel leads agree. Otherwise we can keep morning and reserve a lactation room + mini-fridge and provide electric kettle. Which does the candidate prefer?
Tara M.: She prefers evening but said morning would be okay if lactation support is available. I'll ask her to confirm preference.
Ken (Recruiter): Panel leads: @Maya, @Carlos, @Lee — can any of you do 6pm? If not we'll default to lactation room.
Maya: I can do 6:00-7:30.
Carlos: I can too but prefer remote for the last panel.
Lee: I cannot available after 5pm, morning only.
Arman (People Ops): Ok mixed availability. Let's propose two options to candidate: (A) evening loop 6:00 PM with hybrid panel (Carlos remote) or (B) morning loop with lactation room + private fridge + electric kettle + 30-min buffer for pumping. Also we can provide a quiet, locked room for expressing and a labeled cooler pack.
Tara M.: Candidate replied: strongly prefers evening to avoid daycare pickup conflicts. Asked whether we can reimburse childcare for an extra hour if evening accepted.
Arman (People Ops): We don't have an official recurring childcare stipend but can approve a one-off caregiver reimbursement up to $120 for evening interviews on a case-by-case basis. Approving for Esha.
Ken (Recruiter): Great. Also Esha asked if she can bring her own pump and whether we provide an outlet extension and privacy sign.
Arman (People Ops): Yes to pump, we'll provide extension, lockable door, and a sign. Also fridge space reserved in Reception labeled "Esha B. - Milk". Please note front desk will store for the day.
reception-bot: Lactation room reserved: "Quiet Room 6" from 8:00-11:30 AM and 5:30-7:45 PM. Mini-fridge reserved and labeled. Access instructions printed on badge envelope.
Ken (Recruiter): We'll go with evening 6:00 PM loop since Maya & Carlos can make it and Lee will do morning if needed. I'll confirm with Lee that alternate panelist will cover his slot if evening proceeds.
Tara M.: Also she asked about travel: arriving by Caltrain and wants to know if we validate mobile ticket screenshots.
Arman (People Ops): Yes, Caltrain screenshots with timestamp + station info are fine. Expense email: expenses@redwood.com subject line: "Candidate Travel - Esha B". For caregiver reimbursement, candidate should attach the caregiver invoice or photo of payment.
Ken (Recruiter): For equipment: she prefers to use her own laptop but needs an external USB-C monitor for pairing test. Can we have a small monitor + HDMI adapter on standby?
Arman (People Ops): Monitor and HDMI->USB-C adapter reserved and labeled "Esha B - monitor". Also pack a spare surge adapter.
interview-bot: Calendar updated: proposed evening loop 6:00 PM; sends RSVP to panelists and candidate. Reminder set 2 hours prior.
Tara M.: I'll message Esha now with evening option + childcare reimbursement details + lactation room fallback plan. Thanks team.
Arman (People Ops): One more: please include instructions that lactation room is single-occupancy and front desk will escort if needed. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
